title: BAFU 2026 v1 elementary flows → EF 3.1 characterization flow keys, by public matching
description: Third bafu-2026-v1 → ef-3.1 bridge, ranked below ranks 3 and 6; holds only flows neither maps. Generated by sentier-importers (sources/bafu/mappings_biosphere_matched, package matching/) from public inputs only: BAFU flow names, EF synonyms (sentier-vocab alt_labels), CAS numbers, qualifier spellings, a land-use class rule, an ecoinvent-v2 ore-composite rule (leading element) and a curated alias table, matched against the EF 3.1 flows that carry a factor in sentier-methods. Tier order: name, land-use class, ore composite, synonym, qualifier, carbon oxide, ion, alias, the same tiers on the region-stripped name, then CAS. Placement is strict on sub-compartment (whole EF context leaf, same compartment) with two explicit, commented fallbacks: the EF unspecified context, and, for BAFU resource sub-compartments that carry no information (unspecified, land, biotic; in ground for water), the sole EF resource branch holding the substance. Target units are the EF reference units inferred from method membership (kilogram; kBq for radionuclides; cubic meter for water; megajoule for fossil energy resources; m2 or m2*a for land); a conversion_factor appears only for fixed same-substance factors (Bq→kBq, water kg→m3) and for the ecoinvent v2 net calorific values of six fossil/nuclear resource flows (hard coal 19.1, brown coal 9.9, crude oil 45.8, peat 9.9 MJ/kg; natural gas 38.3 MJ/Nm3; uranium 560000 MJ/kg; coal-mine off-gas approximated as natural gas at 38.3 MJ/m3), each commented; every other dimension cross is withheld. Decisions of 2026-09-13, all commented: fossil water → Ground Water; Nitrogen to water → Nitrogen, Total (excluding N2); ion-form source names (Arsenic, ion; Calcium II; Copper ion) → the EF element flow unless a CAS-verified species flow exists; unqualified Carbon dioxide / Carbon monoxide emitted to air → the EF (fossil) flows; Carbon dioxide, in air uptake → carbon dioxide (biogenic). Regionalised water and land names (Water, KR) carry the ISO code as target.location. Comments are caveats only. coverage.json (non-normative) has one row for every bafu-2026-v1 flow: mapped (bridge 3, 6, 7 or 8, tier, placement) or unmapped with a reason. Regenerate with a fresh --cache-dir: python -m sentier_importers run bafu-ef-biosphere-matched --deliver-local ~/dds/sentier-mappings, then bafu-ef-biosphere-nomenclature (rank 8), then bafu-ef-coverage.
